# Macau Daily Times

> > English-language daily newspaper covering Macau, China, and regional news with focus on politics, business, international relations, and local affairs.

The Macau Daily Times (澳門每日時報) provides comprehensive coverage of Macau SAR and Greater China region, featuring political analysis, economic developments, and international news. Led by editor Kowie Geldenhuys and featuring columnists like Paulo Coutinho and Catarina Pinto, the publication serves as a primary English news source for Macau.

## Key Topics

- Macau politics and governance
- China-US relations
- Democracy and referendum debates
- Liaison Office
- Portuguese-speaking countries cooperation
- Regional security (RIMPAC, PLA Navy)
- Economic policy and trade
- Local crime and public safety
- Technology and innovation
- Sports and culture in Macau
- British Consulate relations
- Pacific Ocean geopolitics
- Gaming and entertainment industry
- AVFM (Macau Football Association)
- Cross-border cooperation

## Macau Politics & Governance

- [Liaison Office sides with gov't in opposition to democracy referendum](https://macaudailytimes.com.mo/liaison-office-sides-with-govt-in-opposition-to-democracy-referendum.html): Li Gang's Liaison Office opposes Macau democracy referendum initiative
- [Insight: Burying the 'referendum' alive](https://macaudailytimes.com.mo/insight-burying-referendum-alive.html): Paulo Barbosa opinion piece on Macau's unofficial referendum debate
- [COOPERATION | Forum implements first course outside Macau](https://macaudailytimes.com.mo/cooperation-forum-implements-first-course-outside-macau.html): Portuguese-speaking countries forum holds first training course in Portugal

## International Relations & Security

- [RIMPAC | Beijing sends spy ship as vessels join largest US naval drill](https://macaudailytimes.com.mo/rimpac-beijing-sends-spy-ship-vessels-join-largest-us-naval-drill.html): China sends PLA Navy vessels and spy ship to US RIMPAC naval exercise
- [US-CHINA | Strategic talks get test this week](https://macaudailytimes.com.mo/us-china-strategic-talks-get-test-this-week.html): US-China bilateral negotiations tested with Kerry, Lew in Beijing talks
- [Finance minister Lou says it's up to US to drive global economy](https://macaudailytimes.com.mo/finance-minister-lou-says-its-up-to-us-to-drive-global-economy.html): China's Lou Jiwei says US should lead global economic stimulus efforts
- [GERMANY | Berlin asks top US spy to leave the country](https://macaudailytimes.com.mo/germany-berlin-asks-top-us-spy-to-leave-the-country.html): Germany expels top US intelligence official over espionage dispute
